title: Preview a scoped customer order and receivable evidence packet
description: User scene: from a customer invoice, preview that customer's sales orders alongside invoice and explicit receipt-allocation evidence as two separate bounded sections. Both sections independently recheck their existing ERP menu permission and SalespersonDataScopeService scope; deny the entire response if either side fails. Do not infer invoice-to-order linkage, settlement, account balance or collection status. Existing HTTP operation audit records the read-only preview. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify API/UI tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated packet endpoint requires a positive customer Id, bounded date/page filters and both existing sales-order and customer menu permissions; it calls the two scoped report query interfaces and fails closed without partial results.

Response keeps sales orders and invoice/receipt-allocation evidence in separate sections with independent counts, original currency and unknown remaining labels; it never fabricates a cross-document link.
Customer invoice page opens the packet preview with safe empty/error states; tests cover dual permission, customer scope, page cap, no inferred links and no writes; document evidence limits.
